title: --138. (7--12) Samudda1--
text: 3. Idha- -bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇam nibbānapabbāram || evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento- -bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Gaṅgāpeyyālī || || Tassuddānaṃ || || Cha pācīnato ninnā || cha ninnā ca samuddato || Ete dve cha dvādasā honti || Vaggo tena pavuccatī ti || || Nibbānaninno dvādasakī || || catutthakī chaṭṭhānavakī || || CHAPTER V. APPAMĀDAVAGGO PAÑCAMO.
